english.title: Contravene a condition of the consent given to make a deposit of building materials / excavation in a street
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse contravened a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), subject to which a consent to

(A)_[temporarily deposit building materials, rubbish or other things]_
(B)_[make a temporary excavation]_

in the street at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) under section 171 of the Highways Act 1980 was given to you in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171(6)(a) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) Section 312 states that proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
